purpose_context: When built-in doctrine content moved to packs/built-in, the codebase turned out to resolve its on-disk location in many independent places — one of which can silently fall back to an empty set. This mission gives built-in location a single enforced authority and finishes the move, so doctrine either loads correctly or fails loudly, closing a class of silent-misconfiguration risk and de-risking a future packaging split.
purpose_tldr: Give built-in doctrine one fail-closed place to live on disk and prove the packs/built-in move is complete, so the platform can never silently load an empty doctrine set.
source_description: Research-led finalization mission (Mission 1 of 2) completing the packs/built-in relocation and consolidating built-in doctrine location onto one fail-closed seam. Closes #3090/#3119/#3106/#3116/#3120 (the relocation #3090 rides this PR per C-003). Research+design synthesis in scratchpad mission-inputs/research-synthesis.md.
